notes: Reached via Chrome only. robots.txt (fetched in-tab) has an explicit 'User-agent: anthropic-ai / Allow: /' entry -- no block. Chumbak is a Shopify store; the prior Home-Decor pass (archive c292, notes/248.md) reported furniture as absent, but that pass deliberately excluded furniture from its own scope (it never looked) -- this pass found a genuine, sizeable furniture vertical. The site's mega-menu column 'Furniture & Furnishing' (/pages/furniture) only lists 3 sub-links (Wing Chairs & Sofas, Pouffes, Breakfast Tables) -- classic nav under-reporting (brief 7b trap 1). The true, complete taxonomy was found on the department page itself: https://www.chumbak.com/collections/furniture (h1 'Furniture', rendered header '425 products') exposes its own 'Category' filter facet with exactly 3 values that sum exactly to the department total: Arm Chairs and Sofas (152), Benches and stools (243), Wing Chairs (30) = 425. Each was verified independently by navigating directly to the canonical filtered URL (?filter.p.m.custom_filters.category=<value>) and reading the rendered 'N products' header plus the active-filter chip confirming node identity; all three matched the facet label exactly and product tiles were manually spot-checked as genuine furniture (arm chairs, folding chairs, colonial couches, love seats, wing chairs, benches, ottomans, foot rests/pouffes -- no off-scope items). Full crawl of /collections.json (554 collections site-wide) surfaced ~25 additional ad-hoc/legacy furniture-flavoured collection handles (arm-chairs, arm-chairs-foot-stools, benches, colonial-couch, easy-sofa-chairs, memsaab-arm-chair, nawaab-arm-chair, ottomans, ottomans-1, pouffes-benches, pouffs-stools, seating, side-occasional-tables, sofas, sofas-1, stools, storage-shelving, study-dining-chairs, tables, vanity-chairs, accent-furniture, wing-chair-sofas, wing-chairs, furniture-furnishing, furniture-furnishings) -- spot checks (products.json) showed these heavily overlap each other and the 3 clean facet buckets (e.g. arm-chairs-foot-stools' own sample product was a wing chair, easy-sofa-chairs' sample was also a wing chair), so using them as separate leaf rows would double/triple-count the same SKUs. The exhaustive, non-overlapping Category facet was used instead as the sole authoritative subcategory split; none of the ad-hoc handles were emitted as rows. Also excluded: bookcases and chests-dressers (products.json = 0, not linked from nav or the Category facet -- dead/orphaned handles, not live listing pages); Breakfast Tables (nav item, 3 products) -- opened and inspected: 2 of 3 SKUs are 'Foldable Breakfast Tray' items (serveware/trays, out of scope) and only 1 ('Fun Foldable Breakfast Table') is genuine furniture, so primary-product-type fails and the node was dropped rather than emitting a misleading count; confirmed via products.json that none of the Breakfast Tables titles appear in the main 425-item furniture collection anyway. Also excluded as marketing/sale/occasion junk per section 3: furniture-best-selling, furniture-on-sale, furniture-sale, flat-40-off-eoss-furniture, discounted-furniture ('THE WISE OWL SALE - FURNITURE'), fathers-day-furniture-storage, non-furniture (excluded by its own name). Also excluded as out-of-category for Furniture (textile/tableware/decor, belong to other category tasks): bed-furnishing, bed-furnishings-best-selling, bed-linen, cushions-furniture, serving-tableware, dining-table-accessories, table-accessories, table-decor, table-linen, table-runner-mats, tableware, table-wall-decor, storage-jars-and-trunks, trunks-suitcases (Trunks & Storage, a Home Decor nav item, not Furniture). Sanity checks: the 3 counts differ from each other and from the site-wide total (not a constant); none are suspiciously round; h1 stayed 'Furniture' across filtered URLs but the active-filter chip and product tiles confirmed correct node identity each time; two independent reads (pre-filter facet label and post-filter rendered header) agreed exactly for all three nodes.
